content.about: At Insights Opinion, we offer comprehensive quantitative market research services designed to give businesses clear, measurable answers. Our services include Online Surveys, CATI, CAPI, and CLT, covering every stage from data collection through analysis and reporting.

what.description: Quantitative market research collects structured, numerical data from defined audiences. It gives you findings you can measure, compare, and act on with confidence.
cards: Measure how customers feel about your product or brand across a large sample
Track changes in satisfaction, awareness, or preference over time
Validate a new product, concept, or pricing decision with real data
Size a market or estimate demand before entering a new segment
Compare results across regions, demographics, or audience groups

faqs.question: What is quantitative market research?
faqs.answer: Quantitative research collects structured numerical data to measure behaviours, preferences, awareness, and market patterns.

faqs.question: Which quantitative method should I use?
faqs.answer: The right method depends on the audience, sample, market, questionnaire complexity, and collection requirements.

faqs.question: Can quantitative research run internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes. We coordinate multi-country studies with central management and local-language fieldwork support.

faqs.question: How is quantitative data delivered?
faqs.answer: Deliverables can include clean data, cross-tabs, statistical analysis, charts, dashboards, and reports.

children.title: Online Surveys (CAWI)
children.description: Self-administered web surveys across our 8M+ verified panel. Fast turnaround, rich media support, and multi-layer quality controls for nationally representative consumer and B2B data.

children.title: Computer-Assisted Telephone Interviewing (CATI)
children.description: Trained interviewers conduct structured phone interviews with real-time supervision. Ideal for B2B, healthcare, and audiences harder to reach through digital panels.

children.title: Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI)
children.description: Face-to-face field interviews using tablet-based data capture with GPS-verified quality controls. Best for in-home studies, physical product testing, and non-digital populations.

children.title: Central Location Testing (CLT)
children.description: Controlled venue-based testing for products, concepts, and packaging. Enables direct side-by-side comparison under standardised conditions across all respondents.

children.title: Data Analysis and Reporting
children.description: In-house analysts deliver cross-tabulations, regression, factor analysis, and predictive modelling, with clear reports designed for confident stakeholder presentation.
